notes: Settings - More reads as a list of menus now: the Notification player, Works offline and Accepted file types entries open and close with a tap, the way Check for updates and the tutorial summary already did.
The notification player keeps its place above Replay tutorial, and its header row says whether the phone player is On or Off, so that reads at a glance without opening anything.
Nothing behind the menus changed: the same description, the same switch, and the same state it always read - the entry is only folded away until you want it.
The header row reads the state the app really is in, and the switch inside it still turns the phone player off or back on, reloading the app once so the change takes.
A collapsed menu is closed, never removed: the descriptions, the accepted audio and archive types and the offline list all sit behind their own headers.
Every menu starts closed when you open Settings, exactly like the Check for updates one, and each one opens with a single tap on its header.
